title: Toilet in the North-East
explanation: A toilet in the North-East — the water quarter and the mandala's most sensitive zone — is held the most serious placement across every school examined.
layoutFix: Move the toilet to the North-West or West.

title: Kitchen in the North-East
explanation: Fire in the water quarter — a kitchen in the North-East opposes the element of that zone.
layoutFix: Move the kitchen to the South-East (ideal) or North-West.

title: Staircase or heavy weight in the Brahmasthan
explanation: The Brahmasthan (centre) must stay open and unweighted (Manasara, B-12). A staircase or heavy fixture there is a textual violation.
layoutFix: Relocate the staircase to the South, South-West or West.

title: Cut or missing North-East corner
explanation: A cut in the North-East corner is a major defect — it removes the most auspicious part of the plot.
layoutFix: Extend the footprint to square off the North-East corner.

title: South-West extension
explanation: An extension in the South-West is a serious defect — the heaviest zone should not project.
layoutFix: Trim the South-West projection back to the reference rectangle.

title: Main entrance on the South-West corner
explanation: The South-West corner entrance (Pitra / Nairrti arc) is condemned across every school examined — the one near-universal door prohibition.
layoutFix: Relocate the main entrance to an auspicious pada on the North or East wall.

title: Master bedroom in the North-East or South-East
explanation: The master bedroom belongs in the heavy South-West. The North-East (too light) and South-East (fire) are both warned against.
layoutFix: Move the master bedroom to the South-West.

title: Toilet in the South-West
explanation: A toilet in the South-West undermines the stability zone.
layoutFix: Move the toilet to the North-West or West.

title: Overhead tank in NE / underground water in SW
explanation: Water storage should follow the mandala: overhead tank in SW/W, underground water in NE/N/E. The reverse is a defect.
layoutFix: Reposition the tank per the zone rule.

title: Pooja sharing a wall with a toilet; store/toilet beneath a staircase
explanation: A prayer room adjoining a toilet, or a toilet/store tucked beneath a staircase, are held impure adjacencies.
layoutFix: Separate the pooja from the toilet wall; clear the space beneath the stairs.

title: Veedhi Shoola (road thrust)
explanation: A road pointing directly at the plot from the S, SW, SE or NW. Schools disagree on whether direction matters (W-10).
layoutFix: Buffer the affected side with a boundary wall or planting.

title: Heavy trees in the NE or centre
explanation: Heavy trees in the North-East or the centre weigh down zones that should stay light and open.
layoutFix: Keep the North-East and centre free of heavy planting.

title: Mirror facing the bed / beam over a bed or desk
explanation: Modern practice; no classical basis found for either. Included because users expect it, labelled honestly.
layoutFix: Reposition the mirror or route the beam away from directly over the bed or desk.

title: Over-elongated footprint
explanation: A square or a rectangle within a 1:1 to 1:2 proportion is ideal. This plan is more than twice as long as it is wide, which the tradition treats as less balanced.
layoutFix: Where possible, keep the built footprint closer to a 1:1.5 proportion.

title: Room in a prohibited zone
explanation: This room sits in a zone its placement rule prohibits.
layoutFix: Move the room out of the prohibited zone.
